parent_arm_seed._note: LESSONS L-34: a resubmitted job starts with an empty checkpoint slot; this pinned export of the parent arm ships as data/parent_arm_seed/ (context.data below) and jobs.m2_first_cell.arm_seed installs it into $CK/parent_arm (sha + parent/cohort/unit-spec identity checked; exit 10 otherwise), so parent_g12 + parent_index (~68 GPU min) are skipped. Rate reports are not installed: reprice uses the seed_verify probe factor estimate measured on this box. Runs under the parent_g12 cap (it replaces both parent phases).
